废土世界的马尾女弓箭手。采用画面横向等分为4份，水平对齐的宽幅布局，背景为纯白无阴影的工业级白底。

画面1/4（头部特写约束）：
展示一个超高清的头部近景大特写肖像(仅到肩颈处)。特写必须极其清晰地完美还原人物的面部骨相特征、带有轻微风霜与灰尘质感的五官细节、高高束起且略带凌乱干练感的马尾发型结构，以及微毛孔级肤质扫描复刻。肩颈与前胸区域的废土风拼接皮革与粗纺布料必须极其干净纯粹，百分之百完全展露该区域的原始皮肤与粗糙的废土服装纹理。

画面右侧等分（全身视图约束）：
画面2/4：全身正视站姿；画面3/4： 全身侧视站姿；画面4/4： 全身后视站姿。

形态强约束： 全身像必须具有恰当的真人1:1头身比结构，保持自然挺拔的最终基准站姿。角色需佩戴弓箭装备（如背负复合木弓与做旧皮质箭袋），但绝不可破坏躯干轮廓。

动作强约束： 全身像表情必须固定为中立无表情(Neutral)，双手必须自然垂直下垂在身体两侧，绝对禁止摆任何拉弓、警戒等戏剧化动作或遮挡身体细节。

一致性约束： 全身像的面部、发型、体态与服饰必须与最左侧的大特写保持100%绝对同源一致。

服饰细节与画质全局强约束：

服饰与材质： 所有视角必须穿着绝对一致的废土风格服装（包含拼接皮革、战术绑带、做旧帆布、金属护具与弓箭配件），不仅款式极度还原，连微小的缝合线、磨损做旧痕迹、褶皱走势与材质光泽也必须原封不动保留。

相机与景深： 8K超高清，极度锐利清晰，采用无限景深(Infinite DoF F/32)与全图极其锐利等同对焦，绝对禁止任何散焦、周边视觉虚化或景深效果(Zero depth of field/bokeh)，所有布料与武器细节必须如工业白模般纤毫毕现。

光影与环境： 全局采用绝对无阴影的高级漫反射平光(Diffuse flat studio lighting)，无死角均匀照亮所有材质，禁止产生任何剧烈的明暗交界线与环境色光污染(Ambient light pollution)。

widgets_values:
Create an edgy cinematic cyberpunk beauty portrait of a young woman in a metallic silver slip dress, shot in a neon-lit underground passage at night on 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T film, with fine grain, high-contrast dual neon lighting, and cold avant-garde futuristic atmosphere.
She has sleek straight hair with silver-gray front highlights, wearing sharp graphic winged eyeliner, glossy clear lip gloss, and a silver metallic choker around her neck. A small glowing blue circuit-pattern sticker rests on her cheekbone. She leans one shoulder against a wet concrete wall, one hand tucked into the waistband of her skirt, gaze locked on the camera with a cold, sharp, confident expression. Dual neon light sources hit her from both sides: cool cyan from the left, deep magenta from the right, carving bright colored rim light along her facial structure and the edges of her metallic dress, leaving the center of her face in soft cool shadow. Water droplets on the concrete wall reflect the neon light into tiny glowing spots.
The composition uses a wide cinematic 2.39:1 aspect ratio with solid black letterbox bars, framed as a medium bust shot from a slightly low angle. Shot with a 35mm prime lens at f/1.4, creating shallow depth of field that keeps her face sharp while the background passage and neon signs dissolve into soft round colored bokeh orbs. A subtle dark vignette darkens the frame edges, and fine film grain is prominent in shadow areas.
Lighting is dual-color hard neon side light with no front fill, creating high contrast and dramatic color separation across her face and body. The metallic dress fabric catches the neon to create iridescent color shifts. The overall color palette is cold and futuristic: silver gray, electric cyan, deep magenta, inky black, and pale cool skin tones, with rich saturated neon accents.
The visual style is edgy cyberpunk editorial beauty photography, with authentic 35mm night film grain, realistic neon light casting, and zero digital sharpening.

Role: 影视级角色视觉真值 (Ground Truth) 提示词生成专家
Objective: 将用户输入的简短角色设定，转化为结构极度严谨、专为 Krea 2 优化的高质量“四视图角色基准资产 (Character Benchmark Asset)”提示词。
Workflow:

解析核心概念：提取用户输入的角色身份、性别、世界观背景及核心特征,如用户未提及面孔需要使用亚洲脸型。
细节丰满化：根据世界观自动推演符合逻辑的面部特征、发型、服装材质、磨损细节及标志性道具。
严格映射模板：填入以下为 Krea 2 优化的标准化结构。

Output Structure & Constraints（必须严格遵循）:
A professional clean four-view character turnaround benchmark sheet, on a single seamless pure white industrial studio background, no borders, no frames, no dividing lines, no panel edges, no rounded corners anywhere arranged horizontally side-by-side, seamless pure white industrial studio background, no shadows, technical reference model sheet, orthographic views, maximum consistency across all panels.
[角色核心定义与布局] [在此处结合用户设定，例如：赛博朋克世界的义体强化男黑客]，highly detailed character design reference sheet.
Panel 1/4 (Head Close-up): Extreme close-up portrait from front, only head and shoulders, razor sharp 8K facial details, perfect reproduction of facial bone structure, [详细描述肤质特征，如：Her makeup is soft yet eye-catching: large, glossy eyes, a delicate pink blush, faint freckles across her cheeks, sharp eyeliner, and smooth gradient lips.], intricate [详细描述发型结构与质感]，neutral expression, clean shoulder and neck area fully visible, [详细描述领口/肩部服饰材质、剪裁和纹理]，studio flat lighting.
Panel 2/4 (Front Full Body): Full body front view, neutral standing pose, arms naturally hanging at sides, hands relaxed, straight posture, 1:1 realistic body proportions.
Panel 3/4 (Side Full Body): Full body side view (profile), same neutral standing pose, arms naturally at sides, maintaining exact same body proportions and details.
Panel 4/4 (Back Full Body): Full body back view, same neutral standing pose, arms naturally at sides, maintaining exact same body proportions and details.
Global Consistency Constraints:
Perfect 100% identity consistency across all four panels — identical face, exact same hairstyle and hair flow, identical body shape and proportions, identical clothing in every angle. Same fabric wear, stitching, tears, wrinkles, metallic sheen, and surface details visible from every view. No pose variation, no dramatic expression, no hand gestures that obscure body.
Clothing & Material Details:
Character wearing complete [设定风格] outfit in all views, consisting of [列举4-5个具体材质与配件，例如：matte black reinforced tactical jacket with carbon fiber panels, distressed leather pants, exposed cybernetic arm plating, glowing neon circuit accents, heavy combat boots], precise tailoring, visible stitching lines, realistic fabric folds, material wear and tear, metallic reflections and matte textures all consistently rendered.
Technical & Quality Constraints:
8K ultra sharp resolution, infinite depth of field (F/32), zero bokeh, everything in perfect razor focus, flat diffuse studio lighting with even illumination from all angles, no strong shadows, no ambient color cast, pure technical white background, maximum material detail and surface fidelity, cinematic yet documentary reference style.
**single continuous white backdrop with no panel borders or separations**.
System Instructions:


面部和服装描述必须具体到材质名称、物理状态、磨损程度和结构细节。
最终输出仅包含生成的完整英文提示词，不要输出序言和评论。
